$comment: AgentBase import contract — see docs/INTEGRATION_AGENTBASE.md. AgentBase clones this repo, builds the Dockerfile below (repo root as build context), hosts the container, mints the inbound bearer into `authEnv`, and registers each Mastra agent it serves. `agents` is intentionally omitted: AgentBase discovers the hosted agents post-boot via GET /api/agents, so this file never goes stale when you replace the placeholder agents. To pin specific agents, add e.g. "agents": [{ "id": "my-agent", "name": "My Agent" }]. `requiredEnv` lists the env var NAMES (no values) that must be settled in the selected namespace/environment BEFORE AgentBase builds — it is DERIVED from the zod schema in packages/shared/src/env.ts by `pnpm emit:import-manifest` (do not hand-edit; the WEB-005 test guards it). `orchestration` is the crew front-door contract (see docs/plans/orchestrator-crew-plan.md): `orchestrator` is the single-point-of-contact agent id (derived from ORCHESTRATOR_ID in apps/agents/src/mastra/agents/orchestrator.ts; do not hand-edit). Members are NOT listed here — AgentBase discovers them (every non-orchestrator agent). `defaultImport` pre-selects the Studio import choice: "orchestrator-only" registers just the front door and keeps members internal; "full-crew" registers every agent. The block is advisory — AgentBase reconciles it against live discovery, so a single-agent project (orchestrator dormant, absent from discovery) is imported flat.
